answers_23_questions.q1_target: Nuolja surface downwelling shortwave radiation (SW_IN) in W/m^2 from (avg 1hr)POLARIS_v0_1_SITES_Nuolja_2024_hourly_SW_IN(1).csv
answers_23_questions.q4_available_information: Observations up to origin t, astronomical clear-sky calculation at t+h, calendar encodings, latest NWP issue run t_issue <= t
answers_23_questions.q5_timestamping_rule: Information available timestamp t_available <= forecast origin t
answers_23_questions.q6_causally_valid_features: SW_IN lookbacks [t-24h, t], rolling stats, clearsky_ghi, terrain obstruction, solar elevation/zenith, calendar features, lead-shifted NWP features
answers_23_questions.q7_conditional_features: NWP features (valid iff t_issue <= t with lead shift H_effective = H + (t - t_issue))
answers_23_questions.q8_unavailable_features: Intra-day NWP issue runs (06:00, 12:00, 18:00 UTC), real-time satellite streams across all 8784 origins, future observations (t' > t)
answers_23_questions.q9_nwp_issue_selection: Deterministically select latest NWP issue run t_issue satisfying t_issue <= t
answers_23_questions.q11_24h_horizon_guarantee: Multi-output / horizon-specific output heads (H1..H24) using strictly causal feature vector at origin t
answers_23_questions.q12_missing_feature_policy: Fail closed (raise ModelGovernanceError). Zero filling, forward filling, synthetic substitution, or future truth leak strictly forbidden.
q13_baselines: Baseline 2: Diurnal Clear-Sky Persistence (SW_IN(t+h) = clearsky(t+h) * (SW_IN(t) / clearsky(t)))
Baseline 3: Clear-Sky kt Persistence (kt(t+h) = kt(t), SW_IN(t+h) = kt(t) * clearsky(t+h))
answers_23_questions.q17_required_training_artifacts: 34-item reproducibility package in unique immutable directory RUN_<id>/ including 4 JSON manifests, model binary, hashes, logs, predictions
answers_23_questions.q18_fitted_model_serialization: .joblib for tabular models or .pt for PyTorch neural nets
answers_23_questions.q19_model_hashing: SHA-256 hash computed on serialized model binary bytes and stored in model.sha256 and MODEL_MANIFEST.json
answers_23_questions.q20_independent_replay_protocol: Fresh process loads model binary, verifies SHA-256, generates predictions on test features, compares against predictions.json within atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5
answers_23_questions.q21_reproducible_status_criteria: Assigned MODEL_TRAINING_STATUS = REPRODUCIBLE iff all 34 checklist items pass and independent replay succeeds within declared tolerance
answers_23_questions.q22_ems_blocking_conditions: MODEL_TRAINING_STATUS != REPRODUCIBLE, replay failure, SHA-256 mismatch, missing manifest, or unverified causality
answers_23_questions.q23_post_phase1_conditionals: NWP lead-time degradation evaluation for late intra-day origins (e.g. t=18:00 UTC)
